name: SENSATA TECHN.HLDG LS-,01
summary: SENSATA TECHN.HLDG LS-,01 is a global industrial technology company and a leading provider of sensor-rich solutions that create insights for customers. Their products include sensors, electrical protection components, and sensor-based solutions used in a wide array of industries, including automotive, industrial, aerospace, and appliance. The company is headquartered in Attleboro, Massachusetts.
